python.imports:
import fluentqt
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QHBoxLayout, QVBoxLayout
python.setup:
trigger = fluentqt.Button("Show Dialog", %PARENT%)
trigger.setFluentStyle(fluentqt.Button.ButtonStyle.Accent)
trigger.setFixedSize(140, 32)
trigger.move(130, 109)
trigger.show()
control = fluentqt.Dialog(%PARENT%)
control.setAnimationEnabled(False)
layout = QVBoxLayout(control)
layout.setContentsMargins(24, 20, 24, 20)
layout.setSpacing(8)
title = fluentqt.Label("Export archive", control)
title.setFluentTypography(fluentqt.FontRole.Subtitle)
layout.addWidget(title)
body = fluentqt.Label("Include build metadata and theme assets in the exported package.", control)
body.setWordWrap(True)
body.setTextColorRole(fluentqt.Label.TextColorRole.Secondary)
layout.addWidget(body)
layout.addStretch(1)
actions = QHBoxLayout()
actions.setSpacing(8)
actions.addStretch(1)
cancel_button = fluentqt.Button("Cancel", control)
cancel_button.setMinimumWidth(84)
confirm_button = fluentqt.Button("Export", control)
confirm_button.setFluentStyle(fluentqt.Button.ButtonStyle.Accent)
confirm_button.setMinimumWidth(84)
actions.addWidget(cancel_button)
actions.addWidget(confirm_button)
layout.addLayout(actions)
control.resize(316, 174)
cancel_button.clicked.connect(control.reject)
confirm_button.clicked.connect(control.accept)
trigger.clicked.connect(control.open)
control.open()
